method: Kokoro-82M voices designed as weighted blends of style vectors, then trimmed, given quiet breaths in long sentence gaps, high-passed at 70 Hz and loudness-normalised (RMS 0.08). Mouth tracks are analysed from the rendered audio. From The Bob previs (pipeline/voices/humanvo.py, timing_lipsync/lipsync.py).

anna.note: The Bob: Dr Anna, the narrator. Warm British, unhurried.

bob.note: The Bob: Bob Cofer at sixteen. Quick, light.

cofer.note: The Bob: Mr Cofer. Dry British baritone.

orla.note: The Bob: Orla, first witch. Measured, theatrical.

anabela.note: The Bob: Anabela, second witch. Bright and forceful.

saba.note: The Bob: Saba, third witch. Soft, close.

young_man_gb.note: The Bob: young Baden's laughs and efforts (vo.py).

young_woman_gb.note: The Bob: young Dowie's calls and laughs (vo.py).
